note: STD-537. The authoritative machine-readable form of the typed source-selection vectors of TC-935 (FR-330-AC-10). `selections` are exact FR-322 `Selection` rows; the short labels T, D and U denote these typed values, never identifier-parsing rules. `compatibility_cases` give, per TC-935 table case, the `required_source_selections` and the input `lock.profile_selections` as lists of labels, in order. A consumer reads this file (for example through QUIRE_SPECIFICATION_DIR) and never copies or redefines the rows; the QSpec test asserts they equal the fenced JSON block and table of spec/test-cases/TC-935-contract-package-profile.md.
